risk: Scope expands into a mini-SIEM or universal parser
mitigation: Frozen supported-representation boundary; explicit out-of-scope list; anti-drift controls
trigger: New representation or capability added without evidence-backed requirement

mitigation: Measured 198463-record benchmark and frozen 4 GB working-set ceiling
trigger: Peak working set exceeds measured ceiling on supported workload

risk: Detection or correlation overfits known fixtures
mitigation: Negative tests, anti-hardcoding scan, external evidence, post-freeze holdout and no post-freeze tuning
trigger: Rule behavior depends on case-specific values or requires tuning after unseen evidence

risk: Correlation is mistaken for causality or maliciousness
mitigation: Bounded correlation contracts and explicit does-not-prove language
trigger: Relationship is promoted beyond its source-supported identity/corroboration claim

risk: Response layer is interpreted as live containment
mitigation: Explicit simulation/non-execution boundary in proof and reports
trigger: Response record is described as executed without measured execution evidence

risk: Submission schemas diverge from supplied UBI templates
mitigation: Authenticated template authorities and template-compliant generator
trigger: Required root artifact schema/header differs from supplied template

risk: Network generalization evidence lacks cross-publisher diversity
mitigation: State limitation explicitly; do not claim cross-publisher generalization
trigger: Finalist claim implies publisher-independent network generalization

risk: Holdout detection performance is misreported without a valid comparator
mitigation: Detection accuracy remains UNADJUDICATED; do not derive precision/recall from non-equivalent post-hoc labels
trigger: Accuracy score is asserted from the non-equivalent publisher artifact
